title: ずらして、全段ぶち抜け。 ～SHIFT BURST～
tagline: ずらして揃えて、4段まとめて撃ち抜く。
coreMechanic: 4×5 armour shutter, one core per row. Drag a row ±1..2 (wrap); gear-linked rows move opposite (cost counted once). Cannon column 1–5, FIRE: beam bottom→top breaks aligned cores, stops at hard armour. 6 fixed rooms, 12 shells, 50s.

inputs.shift: pointer drag on a row; on release round(dx/cell) clamped to −2..2; one owner pointer; pointercancel discards
inputs.cannon: column buttons 列1–5 or tap below the board (pointerdown)
inputs.fire: FIRE button (pointerdown; click only for keyboard activation)
inputs.keyboard: 1–4 row, ←→ shift 1 step, Q/E cannon, Space fire (no repeat)
inputs.pause: button / Esc / P; blur and hidden auto-pause

practice: Room 1 only with 3 shells, separate score, no BEST
scoring: Shot breaking n rows: 100n². Room cleared by its first shot with 4 rows: +400, other room clear +100. All rooms: 1000 + shells×50 + floor(remaining s)×50. Score = max(0, destroy + bonuses − 20×moveSteps) computed from totals. Optimal plan: 14,920.
rank: S: all 6 rooms with one shot each and moves ≤ min total (19) + 6; A: clear + ≥4 one-shot rooms; B: other clear; C: fail
save: web-mini-arcade:v1:ct3:shift_burst:best:rules1 (JSON best record), web-mini-arcade:v1:ct3:shift_burst:settings (mute / reduced motion); denied/corrupt storage → in-memory with on-screen note; never enumerates other keys
telemetry: none in staging (no analytics/records calls); Codex to connect existing services in native adapter
art: Procedural code-drawn sprites only (BLOCKED_ART: ImageGen not available/approved in the production session). Not final art.
audio: WebAudio synthesized SE (no samples), voice cap 10, compressor/limiter, mute; not listened to by a human
humanReview: author / physical device / audio-feel / Windows launcher review pending
